method: Official teacher Preparation Learning Goals and full teacher Lesson page fetched (55+55); goal purpose compared against official activity headings/task families; learner raw worked-example preview inspected as context. Publisher pages are source references only; page content was NOT copied.
scopeLimitations: Only original teacher source-goal/activity PURPOSE evidence. Activity headings reviewed but individual protected original activity problems not independently certified; no full L1-L6/math answer correctness/rights/browser PASS from this record.
rightsPolicy: No publisher goals, examples, images, activity prose, HTML, or figure binary stored in repository; only source URLs, SHA256 and independently authored math-family tags.
sourceProvenance: Live SHA256 for official preparation and lesson page at capture; archived teacher HTML inventory SHA256 separately retained. SHA differences do not imply corrupt data.
